checks.observation: A live production tab retained the r40 resource index-fmJguHeg.js. Catalog revision 13 displayed target 1.0.27 with the primary action 'Обновить страницу'. Activating it loaded r41 resource index-bjy-7Ntn.js and removed the banner.

checks.name: Web catalog rollback suppression
checks.observation: The pre-fix r41 resource reproduced a false 1.0.26 banner while catalog r40 was active. After fix deployment 37076992442, a fresh r41 tab with the same r40 catalog showed no banner.

checks.name: Android direct release A to B action
checks.observation: Signed 1.0.26+40 and 1.0.27+41 releases exist for arm64-v8a, armeabi-v7a and x86_64 with the same measured certificate. Production revision 13 returns the 1.0.27 release page for all three selectors; controller, action-policy and evaluator tests passed in CI.

checks.name: Windows direct release A to B action
checks.observation: The published 1.0.26 and 1.0.27 ZIP hashes matched SHA256SUMS. Both extracted executables launched and remained responsive; production revision 13 returns the 1.0.27 release page for windows/direct/stable/x64.

checks.name: Offline stale result and foreground resume
checks.observation: Web and Flutter controller suites cover stale response rejection, origin changes, retry policy and foreground or online checks; release CI passed.

limitations: No Android device or emulator was connected on the final Windows host, so installing 1.0.26 and tapping through to 1.0.27 on Android remains NOT_RUN.
Windows OpenGL content was not readable in the host screenshot capture, so the native banner click itself remains NOT_RUN even though both portable builds launched and the action contract passed.
The Windows artifact manifest records signing.status=unsigned because no Authenticode certificate is configured.
remaining: Optional hardware-only acceptance: repeat the Android tap-through on a connected device and capture the Windows native banner with a GPU-aware recorder. Release delivery and the production update path are active.
